name: Kura Kura High
source:
Prom day is approaching and our main character Yaoyi has not found her prom partner yet. While living his daily life, there are surprises waiting for him in unexpected places.

[From [url=https://monshim.itch.io/kura-kura-high]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
毕业舞会的日子日渐临近，主角Yaoyi却还没有找到舞伴。平凡的日常中，意想不到的地方正有惊喜等着Yaoyi。

[摘自[url=https://monshim.itch.io/kura-kura-high]Itch.io[/url]]
